description: Single-agent consistent scoring - 100 random USE phrases

phrases.english: I have been trying to understand this for a while.
phrases.other: 我试着了解这个一会儿了。

phrases.english: That young man said he has finished the work.
phrases.other: 那个年轻的男人说他做完工作了。

phrases.english: She wants to stop and come back later on to speak with us.
phrases.other: 她想停止，以后回来和我们说。

phrases.english: He thinks she left them somewhere in the office today
phrases.other: 他觉得她今天把它们留在办公室什么地方了

phrases.english: We all need to be patient when doing this work.
phrases.other: 我们做这个工作的时候都需要有耐心。

phrases.english: Because she didn't sleep well and doesn't feel good.
phrases.other: 因为她睡不好和感觉不好。

phrases.english: I think you left them at work
phrases.other: 我觉得你把它们留在工作的地方了

phrases.english: We can work on this difficult matter together with them.
phrases.other: 我们可以跟他们一起做这个难的事。

phrases.english: He is the only person who can answer all of his difficult questions.
phrases.other: 他是唯一可以回答他所有难的问的人。

phrases.english: Her son wants to find a good job at the council.
phrases.other: 她儿子想在政府找一个好工作。

phrases.english: in that case/if so
phrases.other: 的话

phrases.english: I am going to say something to someone else in Chinese.
phrases.other: 我要用中文和别人说一些东西。

phrases.english: I am going to try to say my meaning in Chinese with someone else.
phrases.other: 我要试着用中文和别人说我的意思。

phrases.english: I want to say something to you in Chinese now.
phrases.other: 我现在想用中文和你说一些东西。

phrases.english: At the moment I feel okay but a bit tired.
phrases.other: 现在我感觉还可以但是有点累。

phrases.english: My friend answered all the questions this morning.
phrases.other: 我的朋友今天早上回答了所有的问题。

phrases.english: I like feeling as if I am nearly ready to go this evening.
phrases.other: 我喜欢感觉好像我今天晚上快要走了。

phrases.english: That is right, he has not seen your friend anywhere here today
phrases.other: 是的，他今天没有在这儿看到你的朋友

phrases.english: We want to learn how to use Chinese in our work.
phrases.other: 我们想学怎么在工作中用中文。

phrases.english: Tomorrow someone else will practice the whole thing with you.
phrases.other: 明天别人会和你练习整个东西。

phrases.english: When we get together I want to tell you something.
phrases.other: 我们一起我想告诉你东西。

phrases.english: Why did you want to speak with him this morning?
phrases.other: 你为什么今天早上想和他说话？

phrases.english: I want you to learn Chinese together with everyone else.
phrases.other: 我想让你和别人一起学中文。

phrases.english: He hopes this will be a big thing for learning new words.
phrases.other: 他希望这个为学新词会是大东西。

phrases.english: Are you going to take the next one or wait a while more?
phrases.other: 你要坐下一个还是等一会儿？

phrases.english: Why do you think this work is so good for us?
phrases.other: 为什么你觉得这个工作对我们那么好？

phrases.english: fixed/definitely
phrases.other: 定

phrases.english: Yes, I think this is a very interesting question.
phrases.other: 是的，我觉得这是一个很有意思的问题。

phrases.english: Soon she will like helping us learn her name quickly.
phrases.other: 很快她会喜欢帮我们快点学她的名字了。

phrases.english: Because she is looking forward to helping us before she goes.
phrases.other: 因为她期待在她走之前帮我们。

phrases.english: Do you have more things to learn this afternoon after this is done?
phrases.other: 这个做完后你今天下午有更多要学吗？

phrases.english: Soon she will feel as if she can easily help us remember.
phrases.other: 很快她会感觉好像她能容易帮我们记住了。

phrases.english: He can remember when he has more time to learn.
phrases.other: 他有多时间学的时候他能记住。

phrases.english: She said she couldn't answer any of the questions.
phrases.other: 她说她回答不了所有的问题。

phrases.english: There is one person waiting for you at that place.
phrases.other: 有一个人在那个地方等你。

phrases.english: Let us see if we can try harder than before now.
phrases.other: 让我们看我们现在可以比以前努力吗。

phrases.english: I like feeling as if I do not spend before I go this evening.
phrases.other: 我喜欢感觉好像我今天晚上在我走之前不花。

phrases.english: He definitely wants to know what we are doing.
phrases.other: 他肯定想知道我们在做什么。

phrases.english: This is so good that I am very happy to be here now.
phrases.other: 这个这么好我很高兴现在在这里。

phrases.english: Do you mind if I ask you where you want to meet on Saturday?
phrases.other: 你介不介意我问你星期六你想在哪里见面？

phrases.english: I know a young man who just started working here.
phrases.other: 我认识一个年轻的男人，他刚开始在这里工作。

phrases.english: If you like football, we can watch it together sometime.
phrases.other: 如果你喜欢足球，我们有的时候可以一起看。

phrases.english: I do not like taking too much time to reply to people.
phrases.other: 我不喜欢花太多时间来回答人。

phrases.english: We didn't want to let anyone hear the truth about it today.
phrases.other: 我们不想让任何人听到真相。

phrases.english: This is the only useful way we can continue doing this for a while.
phrases.other: 这是我们可以继续做这个一会儿的唯一有用的方法。

phrases.english: What is the best thing you could do for learning?
phrases.other: 你可以为学做的最好的东西是什么？

phrases.english: I am sure I want to practice speaking Chinese with you.
phrases.other: 我确定我想和你练习说中文。

phrases.english: My friend found the thing that will make it useful for us.
phrases.other: 我朋友找到了会让它为我们有用的事。

phrases.english: She said she is free tonight if you want to meet at that place
phrases.other: 她说如果你想在那个地方见她今晚有时间

phrases.english: She was very kind when she saw me feeling nervous.
phrases.other: 她看到我紧张的时候对我很好。

phrases.english: I think she wanted to bring her bag with her last week.
phrases.other: 我觉得她上星期想和她的包一起来。

phrases.english: manner/appearance
phrases.other: 样

phrases.english: She is trying to find out more about this language.
phrases.other: 她试着多了解这门语言。

phrases.english: She didn't know she could learn Chinese this quickly before.
phrases.other: 她以前不知道她能学中文这么快。

phrases.english: something similar
phrases.other: 类似的

phrases.english: She asked which place is good for us to learn Chinese together
phrases.other: 她问哪个地方对我们一起学中文好

phrases.english: That is not the thing I was hoping would happen here yesterday
phrases.other: 那不是我希望昨天在这里会发生的东西

phrases.english: Everyone here is trying to finish within the day.
phrases.other: 这里的大家都在试着在这天内做完。

phrases.english: I am surprised at how quickly I am starting to understand.
phrases.other: 我惊讶我开始懂得这么快。

phrases.english: Let us try to speak Chinese very well with her tomorrow.
phrases.other: 让我们明天试着和她中文说得很好。

phrases.english: Why did he want to ask her something yesterday evening?
phrases.other: 他为什么昨天晚上想问她一些东西？

phrases.english: that one (specific)
phrases.other: 那个

phrases.english: My friend asked if it was okay for him to have more time.
phrases.other: 我朋友问好他可以有多时间吗。

phrases.english: She said we should just do it now and not wait.
phrases.other: 她说我们就现在做不等。

phrases.english: He thinks helping out is very important for all of us.
phrases.other: 他觉得帮忙对我们大家很重要。

phrases.english: I don't know why you think that it is so good.
phrases.other: 我不知道为什么你觉得那么好。

phrases.english: know (information)
phrases.other: 知道

phrases.english: At the moment he feels better than this morning.
phrases.other: 现在他感觉比今天早上好。

phrases.english: I am going to explain a little of my meaning in Chinese.
phrases.other: 我要用中文解释一点我的意思。

phrases.english: We are too happy that she agreed to help us with this matter.
phrases.other: 我们太高兴她同意帮我们这个事。

phrases.english: But he is learning his name very well before the meeting.
phrases.other: 但是他在见面学他的名字很好。

phrases.english: She thinks this is the best way to answer his questions in time.
phrases.other: 她觉得这是及时回答他的问的好方法。

phrases.english: He needs to think about what he can do by himself today.
phrases.other: 他需要想他今天可以自己做什么。

phrases.english: I will not guess, I will try to remember it with you.
phrases.other: 我不会猜，我会和你试着记住。

phrases.english: Why do you think this work is so good for everyone?
phrases.other: 为什么你觉得这个工作对大家那么好？

phrases.english: Is this the choice you want to make today here?
phrases.other: 这是你今天在这里想做的选择吗？

phrases.english: I need to go down to do some work with him
phrases.other: 我要下去和他做一些工作

phrases.english: (possessive/adjective marker)
phrases.other: 的

phrases.english: I wanted to have her help you with this.
phrases.other: 我想让她帮你做这个。

phrases.english: He said he is happy so he does not want to change anything
phrases.other: 他说他很高兴所以他不想改变什么

phrases.english: Did you ask him why he thinks this is not working now?
phrases.other: 你问他为什么他觉得这个现在不行吗？

phrases.english: I like to hear different people speak Chinese in different ways.
phrases.other: 我喜欢听不同的人不同的说中文。

phrases.english: Do you know a bit about what happened?
phrases.other: 你知道一点发生了什么吗？

phrases.english: Let us go to that restaurant together tonight.
phrases.other: 我们今天晚上一起去那个饭店吧。

phrases.english: I am grateful that you helped me understand how to do it well.
phrases.other: 我感谢你帮我理解怎么做好。

phrases.english: Can you tell me if Saturday is good for you to come learn here?
phrases.other: 你可以告诉我星期六对你来这里学好吗？

phrases.english: (possessive marker)
phrases.other: 的

phrases.english: as quickly as possible
phrases.other: 尽快

phrases.english: I don't want a bit of this food at all.
phrases.other: 我一点都不想要这个吃的。

phrases.english: At the moment I am not sure how the story is.
phrases.other: 现在我不知道故事怎么样。

phrases.english: My friend said sorry that she left the place early.
phrases.other: 我的朋友说对不起她早走了这个地方。

phrases.english: Do you mind if I ask you to say it more slowly?
phrases.other: 你介意我问你说慢一点吗？

phrases.english: Because she wants to learn his name from people who speak Chinese.
phrases.other: 因为她想和说中文的人学他的名字。

phrases.english: We still want to learn more different words next week.
phrases.other: 我们下星期还想学更多不同的词。

phrases.english: Of course this is what we were discussing just now.
phrases.other: 当然这个是我们刚才说的。

phrases.english: If you sleep well you will feel much better the next day.
phrases.other: 如果你睡好你会感觉更好一点。

phrases.english: Do you want to come and see me here tomorrow?
phrases.other: 你想明天来这里见我吗？

phrases.english: Did you start to like using your car more than before?
phrases.other: 你开始比以前多喜欢用你的汽车了吗？

phrases.english: I'm not sure if I have enough time to do it now.
phrases.other: 我不确定我现在有够多时间做。

phrases.english: He said he has been to that place with you before.
phrases.other: 他说他以前和你去过那个地方。
